description: Post a comment on an issue; the people following it are notified and the comment stays on the issue. Needs write permission on the repository. An issue is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

issue.description: The issue, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_issue_comment
title: Comment on a GitHub issue
